name: Sticky Greeter
disable: DC 23 Thievery check to disable the pressure plate that triggers the sticky greeter.
reset: The sticky greeters must be reset manually.

items.name: Web
items.text:
Web Hardness 5

Web HP 20

Immunities bludgeoning damage, critical hits, object immunities, piercing damage, precision damage

items.name: Spray Webbing
items.text:
Trigger A creature steps on the pressure plate adjacent to the sticky greeter

---

Effect The sticky greeter lurches as its abdomen snaps forward, opens, and sprays the triggering creature with thick sheets of alchemical webbing. At the same time, the sticky greeter emits a high-pitched whistling sound. The creature must make a DC 26 Reflex save save or become Immobilized and held in place, or Restrained on a critical failure until it Escapes or the webbing binding it is destroyed.

text: A taxidermy giant spider's abdomen opens up to spray the area in front of it with sticky webbing.
